parsed.notes:
Required Skills & Qualifications sets required labels; Preferred Qualifications sets optional labels.
Framework examples form one alternative group; the broad machine-learning skill is outside that group.
Production deployment and maintenance support AI deployment and MLOps respectively; the optional edge-deployment mention does not soften the required deployment criterion.
Literal reading: debugging alone is not software testing, model inference alone is not model serving or inference optimization, and generic performance tuning is not specifically inference optimization; these remain unmapped.
Privacy-preserving AI and secure compute environments map jointly to Data Privacy & Security.
Technologies and practices appearing only in the role description or responsibilities are excluded. Security clearance, customer-facing experience, and soft skills are not taxonomy skills.
